As far as artists go, I really enjoy Phil Noto, Kenneth Rocafort, Cliff Chiang, and even though the list goes on and on I'd say those 3 come up most prominently as the working artists I enjoy a lot.

As far as authors go, I can't hype up Johnathan Hickman enough. His creator owned stuff is awesome, and his Marvel stuff is game changing. I really also like Remender. No matter how bad AXIS was it can never cancel out the beauty of his Uncanny X-Force run. I really hope China Mieville does more comics as well, because Dial H was a series that ended way too soon.
Who is your favorite comic artist? Favrotie author?

So far in my short lived comic obsession I really enjoy the art of Rod Reis, Steve McNiven, Ryan Bodenheim, Declan Shalvey, Stjepan Šejić, and Tula Lotay is a relatively new artist but wow her stuff is beautiful. They all have extremely different art styles from one another, but all are so fantastic!

Authors are a bit tricky for me. I haven't really read too many different ones, but here's my list anyhow. Jason Aaron is fantastic with his creator owned comics and I'm thoroughly enjoying Thor. Kieron Gillen for his work on The Wicked + The Divine. Stjepan Šejić really makes great characters. In his first story that was written and drawn by himself, Death Vigil, he paints this world of the dead and necromancers in a way that conveys such emotion from all of this characters. I'm really falling for Remender in LOW, you don't know where the story is going, but you know it's going to be big!!

I'm almost done I promise!!!

Yes, Jonathan Hickman is amazing! I'm getting into his new stuff, The Dying and The Dead and WOW! Can't wait for more :) Warren Ellis... just because lol

I also can't leave out colorists, because there are two that really stand out in my mind. Matt Wilson with The Wicked + The Divine, and the goddess that is Jordie Bellaire. My first time seeing her work was in the Ellis/Shalvey Moon Knight and omg it's wonderful! Then I started to learn that colors soooooo many other books! I'm pretty sure she does 2-3 other series that I collect. She's just that awesome!

I'm sure I'm forgetting so many, but I can't have this many favorites. Can I?

I also have to give a shout out to Nate Simpson. Nate I think has only done one issue of one comic and that is Nonplayer. Issue 1 came out back in 2011, but because of several things happening issue 2 well finally be coming out this June. That's 4 years later, but it is amazing. I only found out about him when he announced Nonplayer #2 and was able to pick up a copy of #1 soon after. The art is impeccable and the story is fantastic. Really check him out!

Declan Shavley's short run on Venom with Remender is so well drawn. I'd love to see him on something like Daredevil or even the main Spider-Man book. I also left out Fiona Staples, but her work on Saga has been stellar. I really love the color in that book. On that note, Brian K. Vaughn is also very worth looking into as an author. I think Runaways, Y: The Last Man, and Saga are some of the best comics I've read and he wrote them all.

I've really enjoyed the recent Thor run, but I haven't read much Aaron outside of that. I'm a big fan of Matt Kindt, MIND MGMT is amazing as is his other stuff, for DC or otherwise. Scott Snyder's Batman has been super good and I've also liked American Vampire and Severed. He has a newish horror comic, The Wake, which I can't wait to dive into.

I'll definitely try out some of the creators you mentioned! I need to be more conscious of the colorists I like. If you haven't tried the craziness that is Grant Morrison, do so! His superhero stuff is insane and genre breaking, but if you aren't a total superhero nerd like me, We3 is an awesome comic that'll pull your heart string.

I got into Declan and Ellis because the new Moon Knight came recommended. It was superb!

I recently just finished reading the Saga hardcover and was very impressed by the story and artwork. BKV and Fiona really do good work together, but I'm going to have to say they aren't my favorite :x I don't know if it's because everyone around me has kept telling me to read Saga because of how good it is, but I really feel I am enjoying other stories and artists more. Y has come highly recommended as well :)

Aaron is still doing this short 5 issue run of a story called Men of Wrath through Icon. The last issue comes out this month. It's a very thrilling story that's actually rooted in his own family's past. Very interesting read. He also wrote Scalped, which I haven't read yet but was also recommended to me lol

Oh man Scott Snyder, I'm reading Wytches right now and it's super creepy! I've been wanting to get the trades, but I pulled the trigger on American Vampire first. Still haven't read it though, I'm so backed up with books.
